decision.reason: The only evidence, [ev-8a18453dbaf5], is a one-line changelog title. It says the SelfHealBackOff delay is now calculated correctly once it exceeds the maximum. It does not name a configuration key, flag or field that controls self-heal backoff, and it does not say when the miscalculation happened. The proposed exposure is too broad: any use of Application v1alpha1 matches nearly every Argo CD install. It also relies on a "--self-heal" CLI flag that the evidence never mentions. To set a correct exposure, we need the PR or issue text (#20976/#20978) showing which settings enable self-heal backoff and when the delay goes over the maximum, which may be runtime-only.
